coverage: Scoring sweep: the solution and every spec decoy of all 20 levels (all 4 chapters, 128 picks) through the Outcome screen. Title, star count and the Missed / Not safe hint match each decoy's fails_on every time (hard miss = 0 stars + OH NO, soft miss = 2 stars + CLEARED, solution = 3 stars). No page errors.

level_01 by the normal route (Title > map > Chat > Results > Outcome): fail, then 2 stars, then 3 stars, then fail, then 2 stars. Level 2 stays locked after the fail, unlocks after the 2-star pick, best stars go 0 > 2 > 3 and never drop on later fail/partial replays; the progress-v1 entry, level card stars, Campus badge, chapter heading and top-right total agree after every change and after a page reload.

Chapter boundary: failing level_05 keeps Downtown LOCKED; a 2-star level_05 pick unlocks Downtown (0 / 15) and keeps Campus selected on the map. Chapter 2 intro card shows on level_06's first open only, not on reopening.
Downtown run (levels 06-08, fail and pass picks): badge, heading and total update correctly; the chosen district is remembered after each level.
One-time cards: friend cards show only on the first cleared level (not on a fail, not on replays); chapter intro and How to play don't come back on replays; a scrapbook page card shows once.

BEEN HERE / SEEN BEFORE pills: Green Bean Cafe is SEEN BEFORE in level_05 after only being listed in level_04 (and stays SEEN BEFORE on a level_05 replay after picking it in level_05); Koi Counter is BEEN HERE in level_08 after picking it in level_06; replaying level_06 after level_08 shows no pills (later levels don't count).

level_20: a fail shows Try again / Levels, a 2-star pick shows Back to levels (no Continue), no ending starts and ending-seen-v1 stays unset; Try again then the perfect pick shows Continue > Ending; Esc skips part 1 then returns to the map; ending-seen-v1 is set and a perfect replay shows Back to levels (no ending).
Options > Reset progress after the ending: all progress keys cleared, map back to Campus 0 / 60, and the next perfect level_20 pick offers Continue again.
Outcome sounds (fail, partial, perfect, including after Try again and Reread the chat): one result sound plus one star sound per star, page / badge sounds with their cards.
Clue recap after a fail lists only the broken need (Diet: vegetarian, level_20).

bugs.title: Scrapbook page unlocked in the chat is never announced if the player leaves the level before picking
bugs.where: Chat > Outcome, level_01 and level_02 (any level with a callback line)
steps: Fresh save (or progress up to the level). Open level_02 from the map.
Press A to show the whole chat (the Trip Fund callback line is read; lets-eat-scrapbook-v1 now has trip_fund).
Press Backspace (or ← Levels) to go back to the map. The Scrapbook button already reads 2/5.
Open level_02 again, finish the chat, Find a place, recommend Taco Town.
bugs.expected: The NEW SCRAPBOOK PAGE note and card for The Trip Fund show on this level's Outcome (the first time the level is finished after unlocking it).
bugs.actual: Only the friend card shows. The page is unlocked silently and its card never appears, on this or any later visit. Cause: ChatScene.init resets the registry list newPages:<level> on every open, and unlockPage only returns true the first time, so the page is never queued again.
bugs.frequency: every time (2 of 2: level_01 Satay Incident, level_02 Trip Fund)

setup.settings: defaults; How to play and chapter-1 intro marked seen

bugs.title: After a failed pick the NEW SCRAPBOOK PAGE card still shows and can hand over a different need for the retry
bugs.where: Outcome (fail), level_02 (also level_04 with a seeded save)
steps: Clear level_01, then open level_02 and read the whole chat.
Recommend Mole Cantina (peanut decoy): OH NO, 0 stars, 'Not safe for everyone: Allergy: peanut'.
After ~1.4 s the NEW SCRAPBOOK PAGE! card shows: THE TRIP FUND, a memory with Maya.
Click See it: the page reads 'Cheap eats only: the fund is sacred.'
bugs.expected: Unlock cards are held back after a fail, like the friend card is (OutcomeScene: 'Only on a cleared level: the card's tagline names a need, so after a fail it would hand the answer to the retry'), and shown once the level is cleared.
bugs.actual: The page card shows on the fail screen. For level_02 it flags the budget need (the Taco Loft decoy) before the retry, a hint the fail screen otherwise doesn't give. (On level_01 and level_03 the page matches the need that was just failed, so it only repeats the hint.) The friend card for the same level is correctly withheld.
bugs.frequency: every time (2 of 2 on level_02; also seen on level_04 and level_07 fails)

not_bugs: Every decoy's stars and hint text match its spec fails_on, in all 20 levels.
Best stars never go down: a fail or 2-star replay after 3 stars keeps 3 (storage, card, badge, total).
Next level only unlocks after at least 1 star; Next level → only offered on a cleared pick.
Friend cards are not shown after a fail and show on the first clear; never again on replays.
While an unlock card is up, the Outcome buttons underneath can't be clicked (modal shade), by design.
Ending part 2 Roll call column looked empty in a screenshot taken 1.5 s after skipping part 1; probably still animating, not checked further.
R on Results with nothing open does nothing (by design).
feedback: Unlock cards (several friends in a row on a seeded save) block the Outcome buttons until each is dismissed, which slows down quick wrong-answer retries.
